newsitem.title: UK: UK's FirstBus to pay 11 mln stg for Citybus.
newsitem.headline: UK's FirstBus to pay 11 mln stg for Citybus.

text.p: British transport group FirstBus said on Monday it had agreed to take over another bus firm Citybus for about 11.1 million stg.

Citybus operates bus services in and around Southampton and Havant in southern England. The consideration includes Citybus's net debt and the special dividend of 125 pence a share that Citybus had proposed to pay if the offer becomes wholly unconditional.
FirstBus' offer values Citybus's capital at about 5.7 million stg to be paid in 5.7 million stg in cash or issue of new FirstBus shares.
Citybus reported an operating profit of 0.7 million stg on a turnover of 11.7 million for the year ended December 31, 1996.
"The acquisition of Citybus is expected to enhance FirstBus' earnings per share for the year to March 31, 1998," First Bus said.
The share price of FirstBus opened firm at 205 1/2 pence on Monday.
